plain: Visa's specification for AI agents to sign their web requests to merchants with RFC 9421, tagged for browsing or paying, with optional signed consumer and payment objects. It identifies agents and moves no money.
ste: A Visa specification. An AI agent uses it to sign requests to a merchant. It does not move money.

plain: In TAP, a certified AI platform that a payment scheme has onboarded and approved to pay on behalf of its account holders. It holds the signing key.
ste: An AI platform that a payment scheme approved. It signs requests for the consumer.

plain: In TAP, an intermediary that an agent may use to reach merchant sites. TAP only expects it to pass signatures and query parameters through unchanged.
ste: A service between the agent and the merchant. It must send the signatures to the merchant without a change.

plain: In TAP, the layer in front of a merchant site, such as a CDN, trust management system or proxy, that can verify agent signatures for the merchant.
ste: A CDN or proxy in front of the merchant site. It can verify the signatures for the merchant.

plain: A TAP field that hashes the card number, expiry month and year and security code so a merchant can check key-entered card data. The specification names no algorithm or salt.
ste: A hash of the card data. The merchant compares it with a hash of the card data that the agent types.

plain: The TAP object inside the consumer recognition object with countryCode, zip, ipAddress and deviceData of the consumer.
ste: Data about the device and location of the consumer: country, postal code, IP address and device data.

plain: A reference to the funding account behind a card credential, carried in TAP's cardMetadata so merchants can link token and virtual card payments to one account.
ste: A reference to the account behind a card. It links different tokens of one card.

plain: In Visa Intelligent Commerce, the user's instruction to an agent, authenticated with a Visa Payment Passkey or another issuer-approved method, against which VIC releases payment credentials. Visa's client creates it with POST /vacp/v1/instructions.
ste: An instruction from the consumer to the agent. The consumer approves it with a passkey or with a different method that the issuer accepts.

plain: Visa's directory, announced 2026-06-10, of agents and merchants it has verified as legitimate participants in agentic commerce. No public list or endpoint was found in Visa's newsroom or developer pages (searched 2026-10-19).
ste: A Visa list of agents and merchants that Visa verified.

plain: A Visa on-ramp, announced on 2026-04-08 as a pilot (still described as a pilot on 2026-07-30), that lets merchants accept agent payments initiated through TAP, MPP, ACP and UCP.
ste: A Visa service that lets merchants accept agent payments from different protocols.
